text:
Lina H: FYI ran a shadow bring-up of candidate v2.2-int4 vs anchor v2.1-fp16 on the long-context summarization slice in staging. mean rouge up a hair but tail metrics (p95 MRR and hallucination) moved unfavorably on docs >8k tokens.
Omar P: paste the slice numbers?
Lina H: TL;DR: rouge_mean +0.4, mrr_p95 -1.8 pts, halluc_rate_longtail +1.0ppt. samples_longtail ~620.
Lina H: ```anchor: v2.1-fp16
candidate: v2.2-int4
rouge_mean: 0.605 -> 0.609
mrr_p95: 0.862 -> 0.844
halluc_rate_longtail: 0.017 -> 0.027
samples_longtail: 620
```
Tess V: ugh. reproducible?
Lina H: re-ran with fresh shadow for 24h. same direction; p95 delta stable ~ -1.7 to -1.9. halluc uptick consistent.
Gate-bot: shadow-run 7721 finished; artifacts at /runs/7721 (metrics + samples).
Omar P: potential causes: quant rounding in attention logits, KV-cache warmup mismatch, or sampling variance. Did you check per-token loss across token bands?
Lina H: yes — small late-token loss drift. kv-warmup hit-rate comparable. no truncation or tokenization issues.
Ravi S: what's the staged-canary gating policy we used? thresholds and smoothing?
Lina H: staging-canary currently: window=6h, gating_metrics=[mrr_p95,halluc_rate,rouge_mean], thresholds: mrr_drop=0.015, halluc_inc=0.02, smoothing=3-bucket majority, contiguous_required=2.
Tess V: that majority smoothing is brittle on longtail. suggest slice-aware EWMA smoothing + stronger hysteresis for low-count slices.
Omar P: agree. propose a small, atomic rule we can add to avoid bad promotes while we debug.
Lina H: draft rule below (for eng-platform):
```name: longcontext_tail_guard
triggers:
  - metric: mrr_p95
    comparator: delta_lt
    threshold: 0.015
    smoothing: ewma_hl_8h
  - metric: halluc_rate_longtail
    comparator: delta_gt
    threshold: 0.01
  - sample_guard:
      when_count_lt: 500
      multiplier: 1.25
  - hysteresis:
      contiguous_buckets: 3
      cooldown: 30m
action: pause_or_fallback (immediate-fallback if triggers persist 2 windows)
notifications: softpage ops-oncall if halluc_rate_longtail > 0.02
logging: include failing sample ids + embedding-cosine drift
```
Ravi S: I like pause first (halt promotion) rather than immediate fallback for ringed promotions. but immediate-fallback if persistent is good. Also log anchor divergence (embedding cosine) and attention-variance to help triage.
Tess V: add an override: if sample_count_longtail > 1500 and metric deltas persist, escalate to immediate-fallback.
Omar P: pls also add clause to create reproducible eval artifact (100-sample failing set + per-sample diffs + attention heatmaps) automatically when rule fires.
Lina H: will open PR to add rule to staged-canary and enable EWMA smoothing for longcontext slice. re-run shadow for 48h with new smoothing and attach 100-sample failure set.
Gate-bot: created issue ML-8420: "longcontext_tail_guard + ewma smoothing" assigned to @Lina H.
Ravi S: can eng-infra hold promotions until rule lands? we should avoid winging a promote mid-roll.
Lina H: yes will request hold. @Omar P @Tess V can you review PR today?
Omar P: will review after lunch.
Tess V: I can review after 3pm PT. :thumbsup:
Lina H: plan: hold promote until EWMA smoothing and rule are in; if rule fires during extended shadow we'll pause and triage quant attention rounding. thanks for quick eyeballs.
